### Load in Data
```{r}
# get train and test data from rds
song_train <- readRDS("rds/song_train.rds")
song_test <- readRDS("rds/song_test.rds")
str(song_train)
```

### Create Model
```{r}
# build basic lr model
lr <- glm(hit ~ ., data = song_train, family = "binomial")
summary(lr)

# kitchen sink model, incorporating interaction effects and non linear relationships
giantkitchensink <- glm(hit ~ . + tiktok_virality * editorial_playlist
                        + genrerock * energy
                        + genrernb * energy
                        + genrepop * energy
                        + genrelatin * energy
                        + genreindie * energy
                        + genrehiphop * energy
                        + genreedm * energy
                        + playlist_adds_first_month * editorial_playlist
                        + playlist_adds_first_month * tiktok_virality
                        + artist_prior_monthly_listeners * featured_artist
                        + marketing_budget * label_tiermajor
                        + marketing_budget * label_tierindie_label
                        + log(artist_prior_monthly_listeners)
                        + I(playlist_adds_first_month^2)
                        + I(tiktok_virality^2), data = song_train, family = "binomial")

# use the step model to find the most significant interaction effects and non linear relationships
final_model <- step(giantkitchensink, direction = "backward")

# hit ~ genreedm + genreindie + genrelatin + energy + instrumentalness + 
##     label_tierindie_label + label_tiermajor + marketing_budget + 
##     playlist_adds_first_month + editorial_playlist + tiktok_virality + 
##     artist_prior_monthly_listeners + featured_artist + first_month_streams + 
##     halflife_days + slow_burner + log(artist_prior_monthly_listeners) + 
##     I(playlist_adds_first_month^2) + editorial_playlist:tiktok_virality + 
##     genrelatin:energy + playlist_adds_first_month:editorial_playlist + 
##     artist_prior_monthly_listeners:featured_artist + label_tiermajor:marketing_budget
```

log(artist_prior_monthly_listeners)
- because skewed
### Predict test data
```{r}
# predict test dataset with model
song_lm_predict <- predict(final_model, song_test, type = "response")
summary(song_lm_predict)
```

### Put predict probabilities to bins
```{r}
song_lm_bin <- factor(ifelse(song_lm_predict >= 0.5, "1", "0"), levels = c("0", "1"))
summary(song_lm_bin)
```

### Confusion Matrix
```{r}
library(caret)
cm_lr <- confusionMatrix(as.factor(song_lm_bin), as.factor(song_test$hit), positive = "1")
cm_lr
```

### Save to RDS
```{r}
# save probabilities to rds to be used in stacked model
saveRDS(song_lm_predict, "rds/lm_predict.rds")

# save confusion matrix to rds
saveRDS(cm_lr, "rds/cm_lr.rds")
```
